text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Impressive, Trainer.
You've proven yourself top-notch at the crane game as well."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
My bodyguard corps has grown so much.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While this much is only natural, I shall grant you
the privilege of receiving an honor from me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, behold the King and Trainer's triumphal return!
Ohohohoho!!
